description: New York City club DJ and Grammy-nominated hip-hop producer from Spanish Harlem, known for his 1990s hit "Puerto Rico". He spins 1980s freestyle along with hip-hop, house and dance hits, and plays freestyle dance nights around the Northeast, including Mulcahy's in Wantagh.
